topic: Claude Code AGENTS.md Support Guide 2026: Feature Requests, Community Backlash & Workarounds

key_points: Claude Code does not read AGENTS.md natively as of Aug 2026; docs state 'reads CLAUDE.md, not AGENTS.md'
Issue #6235 (most-upvoted, ~4,667 thumbs-up, 361 comments, open ~1 year) closed 2026-08-17 as 'completed' with a workaround, not a shipped feature
Two documented bridges: @AGENTS.md import (preferred — leaves room for Claude-specific lines) vs symlink ln -s AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md (identical files, Windows needs Admin/Developer Mode)
Imports do NOT save context — imported files load at launch, same token cost as inline
Monorepos (e.g. OpenAI repo carries 88 AGENTS.md) need generated CLAUDE.md stubs + CI check, hand-maintenance is unmaintainable
Verify with /context under Memory files, not assumption; symlink prints nothing on success
Kent C. Dodds (Aug 13) flagged research: AGENTS.md often doesn't improve task success while adding >20% inference cost
Skills/subagents/commands/hooks still live under .claude/ — instruction-file fix leaves that tier untouched
The anger is about the close being marked 'completed', not about the workaround failing; issue #34235 (March, 110 reactions) still open
Confirmed on 2.1.243: bare AGENTS.md with no CLAUDE.md is never auto-loaded — that part of the complaint is real
Both bridges work in testing (import, symlink, cross-directory @docs/AGENTS.md); 'refuses to read' claim is wrong as stated
Windows hole: symlink needs Admin/Developer Mode; open bug #81189 — @AGENTS.md import not expanded in VS Code extension on Windows, agent sees literal '@AGENTS.md'
Silent failures = correctness problem found in review weeks later, not an annoyance caught immediately
Lütke's real complaint: per-repo opt-in forever is a policy/rollout 'complexity tax' for thousands of devs in a monorepo
Import is a live bridge; /import (v2.1.213+) and /init with CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT=1 are one-time migrations that snapshot and drift
Recommended: import shim + CI check that CLAUDE.md references AGENTS.md; keep files under ~200 lines
AGENTS.md became a real cross-vendor standard in 2026: Agentic AI Foundation under Linux Foundation (Dec 2025), OpenAI contributed it alongside Anthropic's MCP; 60k+ projects
CLAUDE.md is hierarchical, supports @-imports, +CLAUDE.local.md, claudeMdExcludes, .claude/rules/ — NOT a synonym for AGENTS.md
Import merge order: imported AGENTS.md baseline, CLAUDE.md lines layer on top, personal ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md on top again
Promoting bloated CLAUDE.md to AGENTS.md multiplies token blast-radius by every tool in the team
Recommended setups: Claude-only → just CLAUDE.md; multi-tool → AGENTS.md as truth + thin @AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md shim, single owner edits
Cursor reads AGENTS.md natively; Codex is AGENTS.md-first and doesn't read CLAUDE.md
Since v2.1.277 (Sept 18, 2026), a repo with AGENTS.md and no CLAUDE.md on the path gets instructions from AGENTS.md automatically — no import/symlink needed
Four Project-instructions modes in /config: claude-md-or-agents-md (default), claude-md-and-agents-md, claude-md, managed-only
CLAUDE.local.md is the trap: adding personal notes silently switches Claude back to ignoring AGENTS.md
Feature-flag behavior: first session after install/upgrade may not load AGENTS.md (needs a throwaway session first)
Not on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry; disabled when hooks restricted or agents-md plugin off
Directly loaded AGENTS.md does NOT appear in /context or /memory — look for 'AGENTS.md loaded' line; verify by asking Claude to quote instructions
AGENTS.md support ships as a feature-flagged built-in plugin, not client behavior; switches off with DO_NOT_TRACK / DISABLE_TELEMETRY / CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC
The inversion: enterprise users routed through Bedrock/Foundry are exactly the population most likely to need cross-tool instruction files
pluginConfigs agents-md@builtin instructionFiles setting is ignored in project/local files — only ~/.claude/settings.json or managed settings, so each dev sets it individually
Response matrix for existing workarounds: keep @AGENTS.md import (works on Bedrock/DO_NOT_TRACK, never double-reads); remove SessionStart hook (now injects a duplicate copy, costs tokens)
Fix 1: CLAUDE.md with @AGENTS.md import — but imports in a parent/root CLAUDE.md do NOT expand when you launch from a subdirectory (bug #78697), monorepo issue
Fix 2: symlink — doesn't depend on import expansion; but Windows core.symlinks=false checks out link as plain text containing 'AGENTS.md'; Edit/Write tools refuse to write through symlink (#66559)
Fix 3: SessionStart hook in ~/.claude/settings.json for repos you can't commit to
Decision table: single-package repo → import; monorepo nested → symlink; Windows mixed team → import at root
/import (2.1.213+) makes a one-time copy that drifts — replace with @AGENTS.md after migrating
Native switch exists in binary (agents-md plugin, projectInstructions option) but sits behind an off-by-default server feature flag

stats.fact: Issue #6235 ('Support AGENTS.md') was the most-upvoted issue in the Claude Code repo: ~4,667–5,026 thumbs-up, 361–384 comments, open ~361 days from 2025-08-21, closed 2026-08-17 as 'completed' with a workaround
Claude Code v2.1.277 (released 2026-09-18) added native AGENTS.md support — reads it automatically when no CLAUDE.md is on the path; configurable via 4 modes
stats.source: Anthropic changelog via gate.com, kanaries.net, creativeainews.com

stats.fact: AGENTS.md is a cross-vendor standard read natively by ~20+ tools (Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Aider, Windsurf, Zed, Jules...) used by 60,000+ open-source projects by Dec 2025

Shopify CEO Tobi Lütke (2026-08-25) said he was considering banning Claude Code until it reads AGENTS.md and .agents/skills, calling the CLAUDE.md-only approach a 'complexity tax' causing 'split brain' among thousands of devs

Anthropic engineer Thariq Shihipar explained the original rationale: different model families are not interchangeable and system prompts affect performance; implemented support via the new 'mods' mechanism and open-sourced the agents-md mod
Issue #34235 (same feature request, opened March) remains open with ~110 reactions even after #6235 was closed
Kent C. Dodds (2026-08-13) cited a paper finding AGENTS.md files often don't improve task success while adding more than 20% to inference cost

AGENTS.md support is feature-flag gated: disabled by DO_NOT_TRACK / DISABLE_TELEMETRY / CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC, on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry, in the first session after upgrade, and when hooks are restricted
Imports (e.g. @AGENTS.md) do not reduce context — they expand at session launch, so a long shared file costs the same tokens whether imported or inline

angles: The dramatic arc: 1-year most-upvoted issue, CEO threatened ban, then Anthropic actually shipped it (2.1.277) — support guide timed to the feature release
Pre/post 2.1.277 split: what the pre-release workarounds were and which to keep vs delete after native support

The silent-failure angle: every workaround and even the native fallback can fail quietly (CLAUDE.local.md trap, Windows VS Code import bug, subdirectory import non-expansion) — emphasizing /context verification
The enterprise irony: the orgs most needing cross-tool AGENTS.md (monorepos, platform teams) are the ones locked out via Bedrock/Foundry and per-repo rollout cost
Best-practice matrix: recommendation per repo type (solo, multi-tool, monorepo, Windows mixed team, vendor/upstream repo)
